note: DOCS-ONLY COMMITS SKIP gate-commit, SO A DOCS INVARIANT ENFORCED BY A RUST TEST IS NEVER CHECKED WHEN YOU BREAK IT — it detonates later, in whoever next touches Rust. Mechanism, read from scripts/hooks/pre-commit line 323: the rust_relevant regex matches only .rs files, Cargo.toml/lock, clippy.toml, rustfmt.toml, rust-toolchain.toml, .cargo/, tools/type-audit/ and docs/audits/type-audit-report.md. Anything else staged alone means the hook prints no Rust-relevant paths staged and exits 0 BEFORE gate-commit. But book/src/frontier/idea-registry.md and docs/decisions/ are policed by cli/tests/suite/docs_consistency.rs, which is a RUST TEST and therefore only ever runs inside that skipped gate. Measured today: I added an idea-registry row of 1268 characters against REGISTRY_IDEA_CAP of 600 (docs_consistency.rs line 454). Four consecutive docs-only commits all printed the skip line and all passed. The branch was then RED for every subsequent commit, and the failure surfaced in a dispatched implementer agent working on unrelated client code, which had to diagnose and repair a defect it did not create before it could commit its own work. Cost was roughly an hour of a subagent turn. WHY THE SKIP IS RIGHT ANYWAY: the hook comment at line 318 says the fast path gates ONLY gate-commit and that three other guards deliberately run unconditionally, because scratch is markdown and golden-pins.sql is SQL, so hanging the whole hook on is-Rust-staged would disable the guards on exactly the commits that trip them. So the skip is considered, not an oversight; the gap is that docs_consistency.rs sits INSIDE the skipped half while policing paths in the unskipped half. WORKAROUND UNTIL FIXED: after any commit touching idea-registry.md or docs/decisions/, run make gate-commit by hand, or stage it alongside a Rust change. Discriminator for a real fix: add book/src/frontier/ and docs/decisions/ to the rust_relevant regex, or split the docs_consistency checks into something the unconditional half can run.
